splits.note: 18th shareholders' meeting (23.03.2005) cut the nominal value from MKD 5,000 to MKD 1,000 and split the ordinary shares 5:1. MSE symbolhistory was never rebased, so the raw feed still shows -78.18% on the first ex-split session.

Annual meeting (25.04.2024) split each ordinary share into ten, cutting the nominal value from EUR 562.42 to EUR 56.242. Registered in the CSD on 12.07.2024 with trading halted that day; trading resumed on the new basis on 15.07.2024.
